entries.name: Properties (pixel and shape layer body)
entries.shows: In Pro mode a pixel or shape layer's Properties shows Transform, Align and Distribute, the layer kind's own sections, and Quick Actions that run menu items.
state_reads: layer surface and frame via app.layer_frame_bounds (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:202-203)
re-read of layer content after sections run (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:267)
state_writes: app.ui.status and app.ui.status_error on command failure (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:254-255, 271-272)
commands: Quick Actions menu id via menus::invoke (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:270)
interactions: Enter, focus loss or drag release commits a W, H, X or Y field (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:112-116)
A wheel turn over a field is one gesture applied when it stops (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:95-105)
Link toggle between W and H (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:208-209, 217-219)
entries.control_reach: unknown (no part-specific ui.set or ui.inspect hook; its edits run edit.transform and layer.translate)
notes: Pixel-frame W and H edits use a 0.5 px tolerance; shape path edits accept sub-pixel changes (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:40-50)
Wheel and drag edits are dropped when another layer becomes active, a pass goes by without the field, or Undo runs (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:66-79, #9898)
The inline test module (16 #[test] fns, panels/layer_props_ui.rs:332-989) is not in the test-file count above

entries.name: Transform
entries.shows: Number fields for width, height, X and Y of the layer, with a link toggle between W and H; a typed percentage is a share of the layer size (W, H) or the document size (X, Y).
state_reads: link flag in egui temp data (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:208-209)
ruler unit and resolution via LenUnit::of (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:129-133)
layer frame or shape path bounds (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:186-192)
state_writes: link flag in egui temp data (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:218)
per-field egui temp keys for typed text, the wheel gesture and the percent base (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:80-111)
interactions: Percent typed into W or H is taken against the size the field was read at (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:81-94)
Wheel over W or H is held and applied once the wheel stops (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:95-105)
Link toggle tooltip 'Link width and height' (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:217)
notes: Linked W and H: a change to one sets the other from the box ratio (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:25-31)
Shape Transform shows the path bounds without stroke pixels, and W or H scales the path to the typed size (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:183-192, 183-185)
Transform math is in f64 so linked scaling stays uniform (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:17-19)
W sits over X and H over Y, each pair centred (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:63; test at panels/layer_props_ui.rs:369, #7314)
Percent typed into W, H, X or Y: share of the layer or document, never pixels (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:80-87, #10784)

entries.name: Align and Distribute
entries.shows: Six align buttons (left, horizontal centre, right, top, vertical centre, bottom) and two distribute buttons (Horizontally, Vertically); a button is greyed when the engine says the command is off.
interactions: Hover highlight only on enabled buttons (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:293-296)
Hover tooltip with widget_info (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:298-300)
Distribute needs three or more layers; the engine decides (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:306-307)
notes: Several layers with Background active: Align and Distribute sits above Document properties (panels/properties.rs:184-187, #4608; panels/layer_props_ui.rs:319-320)
Distribute here duplicates Layer > Distribute (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:305-307, #2349)
Gradient fill layers hide this section (panels/layer_props_ui.rs:249)

entries.name: Histogram
entries.shows: Histogram of the document, selection, one layer or an adjustment's source; Expanded views add a Channel dropdown, a Source dropdown (several layers), an Uncached Refresh button and statistics for the hovered or dragged level; All Channels View adds one histogram per colour channel.
state_reads: active document mode and layer count (panels/histogram_panel.rs:548)
interactions: Click and drag over the graph sets a tonal range (panels/histogram_panel.rs:716-724)
Click on the graph clears the range (panels/histogram_panel.rs:725-727)
Double-click on the graph runs Uncached Refresh (panels/histogram_panel.rs:711-713)
Click the warning icon for Uncached Refresh; tooltip 'Click to refresh histogram with uncached data' (panels/histogram_panel.rs:702-709)
Pointer hover gives the level for the statistics (panels/histogram_panel.rs:728, 838)
entries.control_reach: ui.set histogramPanel, histogramRange and histogramRefresh (control/dispatch.rs:652-656, applied at 684-693); ui.inspect 'histogram' (control/inspect.rs:137)
notes: Pixels row counts every kept pixel, transparent ones included; Mean, Std Dev and Median come from the visible bins (panels/histogram_panel.rs:266-270)
Mean, Std Dev and Median show '--' when no visible samples (panels/histogram_panel.rs:747, 754-766)
Colors view mixes bands additively for light channels and multiplicatively for CMYK inks (panels/histogram_panel.rs:572-586, 665)
Stale data or cache level above 1 shows the warning icon (panels/histogram_panel.rs:702)
An adjustment preview draws the original histogram as an outline over the adjusted one (panels/histogram_panel.rs:688-691)

entries.name: Histogram panel menu
entries.shows: Uncached Refresh; Compact, Expanded and All Channels View radio items; Show Statistics and Show Channels in Color checkboxes.
interactions: Uncached Refresh is greyed with no document (panels/histogram_panel.rs:859)
Menu closes after a refresh or an option change (panels/histogram_panel.rs:861, 885)
notes: The channel is one setting kept across view changes (panels/histogram_panel.rs:867)

entries.name: Histogram options, preferences and ui.inspect state
entries.shows: Not visible: stores the Histogram panel options in preferences and reports them, with statistics, to ui.inspect.
entries.control_reach: ui.inspect 'histogram' (control/inspect.rs:137 -> panels/histogram_panel.rs:891); ui.set histogramPanel (control/dispatch.rs:654, persisted at 687)
notes: Unreadable saved options keep the defaults (panels/histogram_panel.rs:113-118)
Defaults: Compact View with statistics on (panels/histogram_panel.rs:91-100)
Compact View forces the entire-image source (panels/histogram_panel.rs:350-352)

entries.name: Histogram counting and cache
entries.shows: Not visible: counts the histogram off the UI thread for the document revision, source and selection and keeps it until one changes; meanwhile the panel shows the previous one, marked stale.
notes: A result for another document or selection is dropped, not cached (panels/histogram_panel.rs:419-423)
Recounts at most every 250 ms per entry (panels/histogram_panel.rs:471, 476-484)
Counted on a worker thread; inline on web, which has none (panels/histogram_panel.rs:497-525)
Selection key hashed once per revision (panels/histogram_panel.rs:362-367, 400-409)
Revisions that keep their pixels, such as a layer selection, keep the histogram (panels/histogram_panel.rs:444-461, #125)

entries.name: Histogram channels and statistics
entries.shows: Not visible: lists the channels each colour mode offers, maps colours to channel levels for the sampler marks, and computes the statistics shown.
entries.control_reach: ui.inspect 'histogram' statistics and channel list (control/inspect.rs:137 -> panels/histogram_panel.rs:899-913)
notes: Level and percentile: a single level counts pixels at or below it; a range counts pixels in it (panels/histogram_panel.rs:287-291)
CMYK channels come from rgb_to_cmyk; a composite CMYK entry averages the inks (panels/histogram_panel.rs:222-232)
Lab a and b map to 0..255 with a +128 offset (panels/histogram_panel.rs:236-237)

entries.name: Color (slider modes)
entries.shows: The Color tab in a slider mode (Grayscale, RGB, HSB, CMYK, Lab or Web Color): a column of colour chips, a row per slider with its value field and unit, and out-of-gamut and web-colour alerts under the chips; the colour ramp is below (see Color ramp).
state_reads: app.session.tools foreground or background via active (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:113)
remembered slider values in egui temp data (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:141-145)
state_writes: app.session.tools foreground or background via set_color (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:119-125)
egui temp keys for values and tracks (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:161-165, 197-199)
widgets_used: widgets::surface and egui::TextEdit for the Web Color hex field (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:290, 300)
interactions: Slider drag or click sets the value, rounded to whole numbers (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:261-276, 225-227)
Web Color tracks snap to 51 steps (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:268-270)
Hex field takes two hex digits; invalid text snaps back (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:306-315, 287-288)
Dynamic Color Sliders off freezes the tracks during a drag (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:196-199)
Click an alert chip for the nearest printable or web colour; tooltips on both (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:354-357, 370-373)
entries.control_reach: ui.set colorPanel {background, mode, ramp, webSafeRamp} (control/dispatch.rs:666, applied at 737-738)
notes: Slider values are kept per model while they still give the same colour, so greys keep their hue and CMYK or Lab values survive the sRGB round trip (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:129-133, 141-145, #3228)
HSB shares hue and saturation with the Hue Cube (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:146-153)
Alert order: out-of-gamut first, then not-web-safe (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:354-357)

entries.name: Color Wheel
entries.shows: HSB sliders beside chips, a hue ring around a saturation and brightness triangle with white and black at its other corners, and an add-to-swatches button under the wheel.
state_reads: panel fill height in egui temp data (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:559)
widgets_used: painter circle_stroke hue and triangle knobs (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:619-622)
interactions: The press origin picks ring (hue) or triangle (saturation and brightness), so a drag that leaves the ring keeps turning hue (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:582-613)
Hue knob reaches 7 pt past the ring edge (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:593)
Add-to-swatches tooltip 'Create new swatch' (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:630)
notes: The wheel fills the dock group under the sliders, with a 28 pt floor (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:561-566)
Ring and triangle feather their edges as egui shapes do (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:573-575, 648-649; #9996)
Triangle picks use the inset geometry the colours are drawn on (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:734-737)
triangle_sv clamps non-finite points (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:700-703)

entries.name: Color ramp
entries.shows: A colour strip under the sliders with white and black boxes at its right end; a click or drag picks a colour, and a right-click opens the ramp menu.
state_writes: app.session.tools foreground or background via set_color (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:516, 526)
egui temp ramp ends during a drag (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:486)
widgets_used: custom white and black box painters (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:494-496)
interactions: Shift-click cycles the ramp (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:501-502)
Alt picks the colour the panel is not editing (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:500)
A drag keeps the Current Colors ends it began with (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:479-488)
Right-click context menu (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:518-521)
Click the white or black box (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:522-528)
Make Ramp Web Safe picks the cell under the pointer (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:510-514)
widget_info label 'Color Ramp' (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:498)
notes: CMYK Spectrum takes a CMYK round trip per vertex, so its colours are cached until inputs change (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:401-403)
Web-safe ramp draws flat cells sampled at their centres (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:420, 438-449)

entries.name: Color panel menu
entries.shows: The panel menu: the nine modes, Copy Color as HTML, Copy Color's Hex Code, the four ramps and Make Ramp Web Safe, with a check mark on the current choice.
state_reads: foreground or background colour for the copy (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:815)
widgets_used: egui button with a check-mark prefix (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:786)
interactions: Menu closes after a pick (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:811, 795, 801)
Copy as HTML writes a color attribute with #rrggbb (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:775-776)
Hex Code copies without the leading # (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:780-781)
notes: html_color and hex_code are also used by the eyedropper copy (canvas/canvas_tool_menu.rs:1461)
The mode list is one section with no separator, as Photoshop's (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:807)

entries.name: Color panel options and colour state
entries.shows: Not visible: saves the Color panel options (mode, ramp, background flag, web-safe ramp) in preferences, restores them at launch, and picks up outside changes; also reads and writes the foreground and background colours.
notes: A change made outside the panel (prefs set, a reset) replaces the live state on the next frame (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:832-837)
Options are stored as ColorPanelState JSON (panels/color_panel_ui.rs:831, 838)
